summary.headline: Judgments for the Ninth–Twelfth Houses
summary.text: Electional judgments for actions undertaken when a significator occupies the ninth through twelfth houses: journeys, dealings with bishops and religious authorities, dreams and devotion, negotiations with kings and princes, gaining offices and honors, seeking royal wealth, and trading or pasturing livestock.
